explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the previous trial was unrewarded after a common transition (it reached the state its choice usually leads to); it is 0 after a rewarded trial, after a rare transition, and at every GO and D2 step. Its size depends on time in the episode: about 8-10 from roughly trial 90 to the end, about 2 around trials 75-85, and 0 before that.
